fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and bites for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rallying Bay
fusions.desc: Bays a call 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 26 resonating damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 4 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Guard
fusions.desc: Barks a challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Reefhound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound crusted with stinging coral runs with you, biting enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
